{{Top|leg}}
'''High Command Base''' was the installation where the [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] was based. The location moved throughout the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The original [[Chrellis Base|base]] was located on [[Chrellis]], but was forced to relocate when an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Sector fleet/Legends|Sector Fleet]] began operating nearby.<ref name="RASB">''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''</ref> The base moved to [[Brigia/Legends|Brigia]], [[Orion IV]], [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], and [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="TEC">[[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|''The Essential Chronology'']]</ref>
